# Dabble Writer

> > Dabble is a cloud-based novel writing software with features like Plot Grid, Focus Mode, and integrated planning tools designed specifically for fiction authors.

Dabble Writer offers a complete writing platform from story planning to manuscript editing, with educational resources through DabbleU (Dabble University) and partnerships like Writing Mastery Academy. The platform competes with tools like Scrivener and Google Docs while providing specialized features for novelists including NaNoWriMo integration.

## Key Topics

- Dabble (novel writing software)
- Plot Grid (story planning feature)
- Focus Mode (distraction-free writing)
- DabbleU / Dabble University (writing education)
- Novel writing and manuscript editing
- Story structure and worldbuilding
- Character development
- NaNoWriMo integration
- Self-publishing for indie authors
- Writing Mastery Academy partnership
- Fiction writing techniques
- Genre-specific writing (romance, YA, horror, fantasy)
- Cloud-based writing tools
- Alternative to Scrivener and Google Docs

## Writing Craft & Fundamentals
